description:
The Modin, cuDF, and Dask DataFrame adapters have skeleton implementations
but are not production-ready. These platforms are essential for:

- Modin: Drop-in Pandas acceleration (multi-core/distributed)
- cuDF: GPU-accelerated DataFrames for NVIDIA hardware
- Dask: Distributed DataFrame processing for large-scale workloads

Current state: Skeleton files exist in benchbox/platforms/dataframe/ but lack
full TPC-H query implementations and production testing.

The dataframe-performance Phase 9.3 comparative benchmarking was explicitly
deferred until these adapters are complete.
